title: Road Rash - Jailbreak
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes): the HUD speed went 0 -> 0 -> 4 -> 0 km/h, found as a byte at 0x03002F98 (only match)

widgets.text:
Health, bike damage, position
Motorbike racing with fist fights and weapons at speed (2003 GBA game)
Health bar for the rider and a damage bar for the bike: either one emptied ends the run

Punch/kick riders while racing; grab weapons
Punch or kick riders next to you; grab their weapons when they swing one
Weapons stay with you until you crash or lose them
Faster bikes are harder to control in traffic

Knock rivals off; avoid cops
Attack riders on your side only after matching their speed
Police chase you in some races: avoid being boxed in
Crashing costs time and the weapon you carried

rows: a story of races to break a friend out of jail

widgets.text: Single races on the game's courses; some courses only open later
Chains, clubs and other weapons picked up from rivals

rows: chains, clubs and other melee items taken from rivals

widgets.text: Cash from races buys or upgrades bikes in the modes that have a shop

Bikes and riders
Courses and bikes unlock as you clear races

Races won
Finish in the qualifying places to move to the next race
Clear the Jailbreak story to unlock the remaining modes
